nfc78d9c640.headline: Deere mpany :  John Deere - 2Q Earnings Call Earnings Call Presentation
nfc78d9c640.summary: John Deere has published its 2Q 2025 earnings call presentation, dated 15 May 2025. The document accompanies the company's second-quarter results.
nfc78d9c640.why: Deere is a major maker of agricultural and construction equipment, so its quarterly results are a read on farm and construction equipment demand.

nc04c213fbf.headline: Kodal says Mali lithium exports blocked due to permit delays
nc04c213fbf.summary: Kodal Minerals is unable to export more than 20,000 metric tons of lithium concentrate due to regulatory hurdles in Mali, its chief executive told Reuters. The miner is British.
nc04c213fbf.why: Lithium concentrate is a key input for battery production, so export disruptions at African mines can affect supply and prices of battery metals.

nb211594b64.headline: House prices are rising in SA — here’s why
nb211594b64.summary: Potential shift in demand toward more affordable housing options is pushing South African house prices higher, amid increased uncertainty, according to The Citizen.
nb211594b64.why: Residential property prices affect household wealth, bank mortgage lending and construction activity in the economy.

n3ce458ba4c.headline: South African rand gains, focus on upcoming Ramaphosa-Trump meeting and mining data
n3ce458ba4c.summary: The rand edged up to 18.22 against the dollar in early trade, about 0.3% firmer. Traders are focused on the upcoming Ramaphosa-Trump meeting and mining data.
n3ce458ba4c.why: The rand is South Africa's currency, and it reacts to trade diplomacy with the US and to commodity-driven export earnings.

n87a280d881.headline: Malawi’s IMF programme ends after only $35 million disbursed
n87a280d881.summary: The IMF has terminated Malawi's $175 million loan programme after no review was completed over 18 months. Only an initial $35 million had been disbursed under the four-year facility.
n87a280d881.why: IMF programmes provide official financing and policy anchoring, and their termination signals risk for a country's external funding and debt outlook.

n2ee55f3096.headline: India’s biggest unlisted company? NSE now has more shareholders than most listed firms - BusinessToday
n2ee55f3096.summary: The National Stock Exchange of India has over 100,000 shareholders and a valuation of ₹4.7 lakh crore, making it India's most valuable unlisted company. Its long-awaited IPO has faced regulatory delays.
n2ee55f3096.why: The NSE is India's largest stock exchange, and its eventual listing would be a major event for Indian capital markets.

ne245f21a01.headline: Rwanda central bank holds key rate and plans to buy gold for its reserves
ne245f21a01.summary: The National Bank of Rwanda kept its central bank rate unchanged at 6.5% and said it plans to start buying gold for its international reserves. The governor said the rate is adequate to keep inflation within the 2%-8% target.
ne245f21a01.why: Central bank policy rates shape local borrowing costs, while reserve diversification into gold affects a country's currency and external buffers.

n2358607867.headline: European property market: Where have housing costs soared the most?
n2358607867.summary: House prices in the EU increased by 53% between 2015 and 2024, according to euronews. In some countries, housing costs tripled over the same period.
n2358607867.why: Residential property is a major asset class and a key driver of household wealth, mortgage lending, and bank balance sheets across Europe.

n559032b19c.headline: 'Implications will be far lasting...': Financial advisor warns US's remittance tax plan could dent India’s economy - BusinessToday
n559032b19c.summary: India receives an estimated $83 billion in remittances annually, much of it from the US. Under the proposed tax, ₹5,000 would be deducted from every ₹1 lakh sent home from the US.
n559032b19c.why: Remittances are a major source of foreign currency and household income for India, so changes to US transfer taxes affect its external balance and consumption.

n7be838cdd4.headline: Worrying trend for petrol and diesel prices for South Africa's motorists
n7be838cdd4.summary: Latest data shows good news for South African motorists in early June, but the picture is worsening as each day passes. Fuel price changes affect transport costs across the economy.
n7be838cdd4.why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport and logistics costs, and therefore into inflation and consumer spending in South Africa.

ne952f661e9.headline: Nationwide announces change to mortgage rules in major first-time buyer boost
ne952f661e9.summary: Nationwide has reduced its mortgage stress rates by between 0.75 and 1.25 percentage points. Stress rates test whether borrowers could still afford repayments if interest rates rose.
ne952f661e9.why: Nationwide is a major UK building society, and lower stress rates allow lenders to offer larger mortgages, which affects housing demand and mortgage lending.

n47953bde5d.headline: US agencies banned from working on SA G20 Summit – report
n47953bde5d.summary: A report says US agencies have been banned from working on South Africa's G20 Summit. The White House and US State Department had not yet officially confirmed the move.
n47953bde5d.why: The G20 brings together the world's largest economies, and US participation in its summit affects diplomatic and trade coordination among major economies.

n7855bdab30.headline: Ethiopia earns nearly 1.87 bln USD from coffee export in 10 months
n7855bdab30.summary: Ethiopia earned $1.868 billion from coffee exports over the past 10 months, the highest revenue ever for the same period, according to the Ethiopian Coffee and Tea Authority.
n7855bdab30.why: Coffee is one of Ethiopia's largest export earners, so its revenue shapes the country's foreign currency inflows and farmer incomes.

ne26f185033.headline: India's Trade Surge: Navigating Tariffs and Opportunities | Business
ne26f185033.summary: India's exports to the US rose 27.3% to $8.42 billion in April, while imports grew 63.76% to $5.24 billion. Exporters expedited deliveries to avoid US tariffs.
ne26f185033.why: Trade flows between India and the US are a key measure of India's external balance and of tariff effects on its export sector.

n9971a8f2fa.headline: Here is how Tshwane will be spending its R54.6 billion budget
n9971a8f2fa.summary: The City of Tshwane will spend more than R125 million on government work programmes and aims to raise an extra R17 billion through investment, within its R54.6 billion budget.
n9971a8f2fa.why: Municipal budgets set spending on infrastructure and services in South Africa's capital region and determine how much investment the city must attract.

n843a66016d.headline: Interventions to revive logistics and freight rail sector
n843a66016d.summary: Transport Minister Barbara Creecy has outlined critical reforms to revive South Africa's logistics and freight rail sector, which has underperformed in recent years.
n843a66016d.why: Freight rail and logistics efficiency affect export competitiveness for mining and agricultural commodities moving through South African ports.

n670f74954d.headline: Qualcomm confirms it is re-entering the data center CPU market, starting with Saudi Arabia
n670f74954d.summary: Qualcomm confirmed it is re-entering the data center CPU market, beginning with Saudi Arabia, where it will provide AI and CPU solutions for HUMAIN AI.
n670f74954d.why: Qualcomm is a major chipmaker known for mobile processors; data center CPUs target the fast-growing AI infrastructure market.

impacts.name: Qualcomm
impacts.why: Qualcomm gains a new data center CPU customer and market opportunity in AI infrastructure.

n0fbca83522.headline: ADNOC seeks EU okay under foreign subsidies rules for Covestro deal
n0fbca83522.summary: Abu Dhabi state oil giant ADNOC sought EU approval under the bloc's foreign subsidies rules for its 14.7-billion-euro acquisition of German chemicals company Covestro.
n0fbca83522.why: Covestro is a German chemicals maker supplying polymers for automotive and construction uses. EU foreign subsidies reviews can delay or condition cross-border deals involving state-backed buyers.

ne3035708df.headline: Deere mpany :  John Deere - 2Q Earnings Call News Release and Financials
ne3035708df.summary: John Deere reported second-quarter net income of $1.804 billion, with the company citing disciplined execution driving strong quarterly results.
ne3035708df.why: Deere is a major maker of agricultural and construction equipment, so its results offer a read on farm and construction equipment demand.

n63e7a4e4f1.headline: Cyprus Business Now: Hellenic Bank, Ermes, Tourism, Lady’s Mile
n63e7a4e4f1.summary: Hellenic Bank announced a 0.33 percentage point cut to its base rate, from 1.75% to 1.42%, effective May 16, 2025. The bank said more than 90,000 borrowers will benefit.
n63e7a4e4f1.why: Hellenic Bank is a Cypriot commercial bank, so its base rate sets the cost of many variable-rate loans it extends to households and businesses. Rate changes affect its net interest income and borrowers' repayments.

nac50395d9d.headline: Americanas’ Q1 2025 Loss Signals Recovery Struggles
nac50395d9d.summary: Brazilian retailer Americanas reported a net loss of R$496 million ($87 million) in the first quarter of 2025, reversing a R$453 million profit a year earlier.
nac50395d9d.why: Americanas is a major Brazilian retailer, and its results indicate the recovery progress of companies that underwent restructuring after accounting irregularities.

n1e7814dc7c.headline: GOL Airlines Faces Profit Plunge in Q1 2025 Amid Soaring Costs
n1e7814dc7c.summary: Brazilian airline GOL reported a 63.7% drop in first-quarter 2025 profit to R$1.37 billion ($240 million), despite higher costs.
n1e7814dc7c.why: GOL is a major Brazilian low-cost airline, and its margins are sensitive to fuel, currency and operating costs.

n4cc5b8ceb5.headline: Eletrobras Posts $62 Million Q1 2025 Loss as Brazil’s Power Titan Sheds Fossil Assets
n4cc5b8ceb5.summary: Brazil's state-controlled power company Eletrobras reported a net loss in the first quarter of 2025 while shedding fossil fuel assets.
n4cc5b8ceb5.why: Eletrobras is Brazil's largest power utility, and its asset sales and results influence the country's energy sector and state-owned enterprise policy.

n5ee9248761.headline: Argentina Drives Brazil’s Vehicle Market in 2025 Boom
n5ee9248761.summary: Argentina accounted for 69% of Brazil's vehicle exports and 33% of its imports in Q1 2025, according to The Rio Times. The data points to Argentina's dominance in bilateral automotive trade.
n5ee9248761.why: Brazil is Latin America's largest vehicle market and a major hub for automakers' regional production and trade flows. Shifts in cross-border vehicle trade affect carmakers, parts suppliers and currency exposure.

n1e9412f4cb.headline: NSE shareholder count crosses 100,000 mark ahead of IPO; stock rallies over 30% in a year in unlisted market | Stock Market News
n1e9412f4cb.summary: The number of National Stock Exchange of India shareholders has crossed 100,000, with unlisted NSE shares active after share transfers were expedited on 24 March.
n1e9412f4cb.why: The National Stock Exchange of India is the country's largest exchange by volume, and its planned listing would be a major event for Indian capital markets.

nee5acdb82d.headline: Sensex up 1,200 points as investor wealth swells by Rs 5 lakh crore; Nifty reclaims 25,050 - BusinessToday
nee5acdb82d.summary: The BSE Sensex gained 1,200.18 points, or 1.48 per cent, to 82,530.74, while the NSE Nifty closed at 25,062.10, up 1.60 per cent, lifting investor wealth by Rs 5 lakh crore.
nee5acdb82d.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark equity indexes of India, tracking large domestic companies on Indian exchanges.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: The Sensex closed 1.48 per cent higher, reflecting a broad rally among its 30 constituents.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nee5acdb82d.why_moved: The benchmark indexes rallied on a broad session gain, lifting market capitalisation by Rs 5 lakh crore.

n2e9606e702.headline: Scots workers suffer £15k wage drop due to flatlining and inflation
n2e9606e702.summary: Real average weekly earnings in Scotland in 2024 were just £8 higher than in 2008, according to a report on wage stagnation and inflation.
n2e9606e702.why: Real wage trends shape consumer spending power and the outlook for the UK economy.

na4694bf6db.headline: China lifts dual-use rare earth export ban on 28 US companies
na4694bf6db.summary: China has temporarily suspended its ban on exports of rare earth elements and other dual-use items to 28 US companies. The measure is a temporary suspension rather than a full lifting.
na4694bf6db.why: Rare earths are essential inputs for electronics, defence and electric vehicles, so export restrictions affect global supply chains.
na4694bf6db.why_moved: China temporarily suspended its dual-use export ban on 28 US companies, easing supply concerns for those buyers.

n9c2f2456ec.headline: Page Industries Q4 Results: Profit surges 52% YoY to  ₹164 crore;  ₹200 dividend declared | Stock Market News
n9c2f2456ec.summary: Page Industries reported a 52% year-on-year rise in Q4 FY25 net profit to ₹164 crore and an 11% revenue increase to ₹1,098 crore. It declared a ₹200 interim dividend.
n9c2f2456ec.why: Page Industries is an Indian apparel company that makes and distributes the Jockey brand under licence. Its quarterly results indicate demand for branded innerwear in India.

nc39548084d.headline: Stabilising the Cedi key to enforcing forex rules – 1st Deputy Governor assures public
nc39548084d.summary: The Bank of Ghana reaffirmed its commitment to cedi stability, calling it critical to enforcing foreign exchange rules and restoring market confidence, according to its First Deputy Governor.
nc39548084d.why: The cedi is Ghana's currency, and its stability affects import costs, inflation and investor confidence. The central bank manages forex rules that govern currency transactions.

nce92bfa748.headline: Republicans Propose Controversial 5% Tax on Migrant Remittances
nce92bfa748.summary: Republicans in the US House have introduced a tax proposal including a 5% levy on remittances sent by migrants to relatives abroad. The measure is part of a broader tax plan from the Ways and Means Committee.
nce92bfa748.why: Remittances are large cash flows to emerging economies, and a tax on them would affect recipient households and money-transfer providers.

nbe255184fc.headline: Oklahoma Republicans tout proposed $12.6 billion budget deal
nbe255184fc.summary: Governor Kevin Stitt and legislative leaders announced an agreement on a $12.6 billion state budget for the upcoming fiscal year. It includes a tax cut, more education spending and funds to buy a prison.
nbe255184fc.why: State budgets set spending and tax policy that affect public services, local contractors and state bond ratings.

nae4c850516.headline: Vodafone Idea shares jumped 4% today; here is why - BusinessToday
nae4c850516.summary: Vodafone Idea shares traded 3.72% higher at Rs 7.24, having climbed 10.53% in the last five sessions. The rise followed a recent run in the stock.
nae4c850516.why: Vodafone Idea is one of India's largest telecom operators, and its share price reflects the financial health of the heavily indebted sector.

nea2557d21b.headline: Syria's finance minister says foreign investors welcome after US sanctions move
nea2557d21b.summary: Syrian Finance Minister Yisr Barnieh invited global investors to do business with Syria after Trump announced he would lift all US sanctions on the country. The announcement was described as a surprise.
nea2557d21b.why: Sanctions relief determines whether foreign banks, companies and investors can legally operate in a country's economy.

nf6eee30247.headline: 'Ban Turkish apples or impose higher duties': Himachal farmers join boycott chorus after Ankara's drone support to Pakistan - BusinessToday
nf6eee30247.summary: Farmers in Himachal Pradesh are calling for a ban on Turkish apples or higher duties. The protest follows reports that Ankara sent drones to Pakistan during a recent military conflict.
nf6eee30247.why: Turkey is an exporter of fruit and other goods, and consumer or trade boycotts can affect export volumes and bilateral trade relations.

naea93fb2b7.headline: ‘Flying taxis’ could appear in UK skies as early as 2028, minister says
naea93fb2b7.summary: Transport minister Mike Kane said the government wants to maximise the benefits of future flight technologies, including flying taxis, which could appear in UK skies as early as 2028.
naea93fb2b7.why: Advanced air mobility is an emerging aviation technology, and government timelines affect investment in aircraft makers and urban air-transport operators.

nfc28e4afff.headline: SingPost plunges 12% on underlying net loss despite proposing S$0.09 special dividend
nfc28e4afff.summary: SingPost shares plunged 12% after the group recorded a 40% fall in net profit and an underlying net loss. It also proposed a S$0.09 special dividend amid uncertain global logistics conditions.
nfc28e4afff.why: Singapore Post is a Singapore-listed postal and logistics company, and its results reflect demand for parcel and mail services.
nfc28e4afff.why_moved: A 40% fall in net profit and an underlying net loss, amid uncertain global logistics conditions, prompted the share price drop.

nf47c86a001.headline: Canada Growth Fund commits $111m for Foran Mining’s McIlvenna Bay project
nf47c86a001.summary: Canada Growth Fund committed about C$156m ($111.6m) in a C$350m non-brokered private placement by Foran Mining. The funding supports the McIlvenna Bay project.
nf47c86a001.why: Foran Mining is a Canadian base-metals miner, and government-backed capital supports domestic copper and zinc supply development.

n5680e28699.headline: UK economy grows by 0.7% in Q1, but tariffs endanger progress
n5680e28699.summary: Britain's economy expanded slightly more than expected in the first quarter, official data showed. The period preceded a business tax change, but tariffs were flagged as a risk to progress.
n5680e28699.why: GDP growth is the main measure of an economy's output. Quarterly data shapes expectations for Bank of England policy and UK asset prices.

nc1b1c7e664.headline: Dialog Group maintains positive outlook for FY25
nc1b1c7e664.summary: Dialog Group Bhd said it is optimistic about its performance for the financial year ending June 30, 2025. The Malaysian company made the statement in Kuala Lumpur.
nc1b1c7e664.why: Dialog Group is a Malaysian energy and infrastructure company listed in Kuala Lumpur. Its outlook statements offer investors guidance on expected earnings.

nd877c9272d.headline: How much new B&M boss will earn as he takes over at bargain chain
nd877c9272d.summary: Tjeerd Jegen will take over as boss of Speke-based discount retailer B&M next month. The Liverpool Echo reported on his expected earnings.
nd877c9272d.why: B&M is a UK discount variety retailer listed in London, and leadership changes can influence strategy and investor confidence.

n128bd6482a.headline: Trust sold several million shares in Pushpay insider case
n128bd6482a.summary: A trust that former Pushpay director Peter Huljich emailed sold several tens of millions of dollars of shares before the company's co-founder's stake sale was announced. The case is an insider matter.
n128bd6482a.why: Pushpay is a New Zealand church-software company, and insider trading questions can affect regulatory scrutiny and investor confidence.

n1025b574a8.headline: SGX RegCo proposes removing financial watch list, avoiding public queries on listed firms
n1025b574a8.summary: Singapore's regulator proposes removing the financial watch list and avoiding public queries on listed firms. The moves aim to reduce regulatory friction and support price discovery and market efficiency.
n1025b574a8.why: The Singapore Exchange operates Singapore's main securities market, so rules on listed-company oversight affect issuers and investors trading there.

nd8266804c6.headline: ‘Diversify before pause ends’
nd8266804c6.summary: Local businesses in Malaysia are being urged to diversify export markets to reduce reliance on a single market. The advice comes despite a 90-day pause in the US-China tariff war.
nd8266804c6.why: Malaysia is a trade-dependent economy, so export concentration and tariff changes between major partners affect its growth and currency.

n42af9ad385.headline: TAG Immobilien benefits from higher rents – forecasts confirmed
n42af9ad385.summary: TAG Immobilien posted a first-quarter operating profit rise of just under 1% to €44.9 million, helped by higher rents amid strong housing demand. The company confirmed its forecasts.
n42af9ad385.why: TAG Immobilien is a German residential landlord, so its rental income and forecasts reflect the health of the German housing market.

n40202c4b37.headline: Cash use accounts for just 15.9% of in-person transactions: survey
n40202c4b37.summary: A Bank of Korea survey showed cash is the third-most preferred payment method among Korean adults, behind credit and debit cards. Cash made up 15.9% of in-person transactions.
n40202c4b37.why: The Bank of Korea is the country's central bank, and payment-method trends affect monetary policy design and the payments industry.

nb0e5087c68.headline: Economists believe 10% baseline US tariffs will stay
nb0e5087c68.summary: The United States and China reached a temporary 90-day ceasefire in the trade war by slashing tariffs on each other. Economists believe the 10% US baseline tariffs will remain.
nb0e5087c68.why: Baseline US tariffs affect import costs and trade flows for many exporting countries, including Malaysia.

n59b4776f7d.headline: Merck KGaA Cuts Outlook Amid Macroeconomic Challenges
n59b4776f7d.summary: Germany's Merck KGaA slashed its full-year outlook, citing challenging macroeconomic conditions and foreign-exchange headwinds across its life-sciences and electronics businesses.
n59b4776f7d.why: Merck KGaA is a German science and technology group with pharmaceutical and electronics divisions, and guidance changes are closely watched by European healthcare and materials investors.

impacts.name: Merck KGaA
impacts.why: A cut to full-year guidance signals lower expected earnings for the company.

na6fb50d2dc.headline: Deutsche Bank applies to ECB for share buyback in second half of 2025
na6fb50d2dc.summary: Deutsche Bank has asked the European Central Bank for permission to conduct a share buyback in the second half of 2025, CEO Christian Sewing said in a speech.
na6fb50d2dc.why: Deutsche Bank is a major German universal bank. Buybacks require ECB approval for large European lenders and return capital to shareholders.

nf38eab4f1b.headline: Singapore home sales fall for second month as demand weakens
nf38eab4f1b.summary: Singapore private home sales fell for a second month as demand for new projects weakened amid trade tensions fuelling unease about the economic outlook.
nf38eab4f1b.why: Singapore is a major financial hub, and its property market is closely watched as a gauge of household confidence and economic conditions.

n6c0b2da99a.headline: Sumitomo Mitsui braces for tariff fallout with more buffers
n6c0b2da99a.summary: Japan's second-largest lender expects net income to rise about 10% to ¥1.3 trillion in the fiscal year that started in April, while bracing for tariff impacts.
n6c0b2da99a.why: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group is one of Japan's largest banks, and its earnings reflect domestic lending and global trade conditions.

n59caa920af.headline: Rakuten Group shares sink on worse-than-expected quarterly loss
n59caa920af.summary: Rakuten Group shares plunged as much as 10% in Tokyo on Thursday after a worse-than-expected quarterly loss, their biggest intraday drop since April 7.
n59caa920af.why: Rakuten is a Japanese e-commerce, fintech and telecom conglomerate, so its results reflect consumer spending and its investment in mobile services.

ned97b2c940.headline: April new home sales dip 9% month on month to 663 units, but are double year-ago levels
ned97b2c940.summary: April new home sales dipped 9% from the previous month to 663 units, though they remain double year-ago levels, driven by two city-fringe launches.
ned97b2c940.why: Private new-home sales are a key indicator of demand in Singapore's property market, which is closely watched by banks and developers.

n7ac8bdf493.headline: Oil prices drop on US-Iran progress; global shares gain in choppy trade
n7ac8bdf493.summary: Oil dropped over 2% on Thursday as a potential US-Iran nuclear deal raised the prospect of increased global crude supply, while Wall Street indexes were mixed.
n7ac8bdf493.why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark, and changes in expected Iranian supply affect energy prices, inflation expectations and equity sectors.
n7ac8bdf493.why_moved: Prospects of a US-Iran nuclear deal raised expectations of additional global crude supply, pushing oil lower.

na6b1290b79.headline: TSX notches record high as investor exuberance grows
na6b1290b79.summary: Canada's main stock index rose to a record high on Thursday, helped by gains in industrial and financial shares. Investors reacted to recent de-escalation of the global trade war.
na6b1290b79.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's benchmark equity index, heavily weighted toward banks, energy and materials, so it is sensitive to trade policy and commodity demand.
na6b1290b79.why_moved: The input cites de-escalation of the global trade war and resulting investor excitement, with gains in industrial and financial shares.

naace0bf035.headline: Trade chiefs jostle for time with Greer at APEC meeting in South Korea
naace0bf035.summary: Many trade chiefs at the APEC meeting in South Korea will seek talks with US Trade Representative Greer. They aim to blunt the impact of Trump's tariff barrage.
naace0bf035.why: APEC is a forum of Asia-Pacific economies, and US tariff policy directly affects their exporters and trade flows.

n4eb10a0a05.headline: LDC graduation offers opportunity to reassess our trajectory: Finance ministry special assistant
n4eb10a0a05.summary: Bangladesh's upcoming graduation from least developed country status presents an opportunity to reassess its development strategy, said a finance ministry special assistant. The government is committed to aligning policies around clear objectives.
n4eb10a0a05.why: Graduation from LDC status ends some preferential trade access and concessional financing, which affects Bangladesh's exporters and borrowing costs.

nebdeebf559.headline: Nuclear deals power 52% profit surge at AtkinsRéalis, prompt brighter forecast
nebdeebf559.summary: AtkinsRéalis reported a big revenue surge last quarter driven by nuclear projects, which the engineering firm said paves the way for better results in the year ahead.
nebdeebf559.why: AtkinsRéalis is a Montreal-based engineering and nuclear services group, so its results offer a read on demand for nuclear construction and services.

n2b8d4596ee.headline: Walmart says higher prices from tariffs coming as soon as this month
n2b8d4596ee.summary: Walmart stated it will not absorb all costs from increased tariffs on imported goods, especially from China, leading to higher prices for consumers.
n2b8d4596ee.why: As the world's largest retailer, Walmart's pricing decisions influence consumer spending and inflation dynamics in the US retail sector.

impacts.name: Walmart
impacts.why: Higher tariffs increase costs, pressuring Walmart's margins and potentially reducing consumer spending.

n2b8d4596ee.why_moved: Walmart's warning about tariff-driven price increases raised concerns about inflation and consumer demand, impacting retail stocks.

nf31a39c182.headline: Iveco Group N.V. 2025 First Quarter Results
nf31a39c182.summary: Iveco Group released its financial results for the first quarter of 2025, providing insights into its operational and financial performance.
nf31a39c182.why: Iveco Group is a key player in commercial vehicles and industrial transportation, impacting European manufacturing and logistics sectors.

n890423a296.headline: Tariffs could hike up your air conditioning bill for your home and car this summer
n890423a296.summary: A shortage of coolant combined with tariffs is expected to raise air conditioning prices for homes and cars this summer.
n890423a296.why: Rising input costs due to tariffs and supply shortages affect consumer prices and inflation.

n4ea25b851b.headline: Tamboran makes progress on Beetaloo drilling campaign after US$55.4 million capital raise
n4ea25b851b.summary: Tamboran Resources Corporation secured $55.4 million in capital to advance the largest single drilling program in the Beetaloo Basin.
n4ea25b851b.why: Capital raises enable energy exploration companies to fund large-scale projects that can increase reserves and future production.

n46911e1131.headline: Rompetrol Rafinare, the company operating the Petromidia refinery, deepened its losses to 37 million dollars at the end of March
n46911e1131.summary: Rompetrol Rafinare, operator of the Petromidia refinery, ended the first quarter with a loss of $37.3 million, deeper than before. The company trades under the symbol RRC.
n46911e1131.why: Rompetrol Rafinare is a Romanian refiner whose results reflect refining margins and operating costs in Southeast Europe. Refinery losses are sensitive to crude prices and fuel spreads.

n01c69d1186.headline: ANSES: people who will not be able to receive the aguinaldo in June 2025
n01c69d1186.summary: Argentina's social security agency ANSES says a specific group will be left out of the 2025 Sueldo Anual Complementario bonus due in June.
n01c69d1186.why: ANSES is Argentina's national social security administrator, and the aguinaldo is a mid-year bonus that affects household spending and consumer demand.

n4e7f16f88b.headline: EGCO Group profit up 115%, tops 3.5 billion baht, driven by proactive asset management
n4e7f16f88b.summary: EGCO Group reported net profit up 115% to over 3,500 million baht in Q1 2025, which the company attributed to strategic asset management.
n4e7f16f88b.why: EGCO is a Thai power generation company, and its earnings reflect electricity output, asset management and energy market conditions in Thailand.

n53f309b1cf.headline: Which Companies' Shares Rose on KASE in April
n53f309b1cf.summary: Forbes.kz reported which issuers' shares rose the most on the Kazakhstan Stock Exchange in April and which lost the most in price.
n53f309b1cf.why: The Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) in Almaty is the main venue for trading Kazakh corporate and government securities, and monthly moves indicate local equity sentiment.

nc289d7776a.headline: House of Representatives Approves Tax Exemptions for Those Affected in Lebanon
nc289d7776a.summary: Lebanon's House of Representatives approved an urgent draft law granting tax exemptions to individuals, companies and residential properties materially affected by the attacks.
nc289d7776a.why: Tax relief for war-hit property owners and businesses affects fiscal revenue and reconstruction costs in Lebanon, a country with a fragile economy.
